turns.question: Of the partner outreach messages we sent from 1 to 3 October 2026, what share got an answer within 12 hours?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for replies within 12 hours, so I can't give that share. The closest metrics are Reply rate (the share of outreach messages that got a reply, counted on the day the message was sent, with no time limit) and Messages replied.
